info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get It Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The IT Management Retrieval API provides access to critical information related to IT management within a development environment. By using the specified parameter, consumers can retrieve detailed management data that aids in monitoring and decision-making processes. This API is designed for developers and IT professionals who require real-time insights into their operational environments. Typical use cases include troubleshooting, resource management, and performance analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific development environment by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a development environment identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). It provides detailed information about the environment settings, configurations, and related resources, helping you manage your IT development resources effectively.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving details about the specific development environment identified by RES-100045. This request is essential for clients seeking to access or manipulate data pertinent to the listed resource.

GetItManagementByParam1Request.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation in the context of IT management development environment. This is a placeholder for the request payload.

GetItManagementByParam1Response_200.title: Development Environment Response

region.description: The geographical region where the environment is hosted.

dataClassification.description: Classification of the data stored in this environment.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date and time of the environment in ISO 8601 format.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: Version number of the environment configuration.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the environment in ISO 8601 format.
